verdict.rationale: Baseten supports asynchronous, long-running jobs (async inference returning results later via webhook/polling, and Training Jobs that run in the background provisioning GPUs and syncing checkpoints), which are background, non-blocking executions triggered by a user request. However, there is no evidence of true autonomous automation — no scheduling/triggers, no persistent agent loops, or event-driven workflows that run independently of a user-initiated call. Missing for 10: scheduled/triggered automation setup, autonomous multi-step agent orchestration, and any evidence of unattended recurring workflows beyond single async job/training runs.
